notes.title: Diana's Quest - Patch 1.2a
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. The patch 1.2a is now live. Check out what has changed.

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
Dark Punishment: now enemies should disappear after they are defeated by this passive skill's effect.
Canyon Mountains: players should no longer get stuck in the first map after talking to Beatrice.

[b]REBALANCING:[/b]
Excalibur: attack power has been doubled.
Mirror Shield: fixed to give +4 Magic Defense (instead of +4 Magic Attack).

[b]PERFORMANCE:[/b]
Screen freezing: should no longer happen on monitors with a refresh rate higher than 60Hz.

Hentai Room Team

notes.title: Emergent Patch (Game returned to 1.1a)
notes.content:
Some people reported the game isn't starting. We're investigating what is happening.

Hentai Room Team

notes.title: Patch v1.1a
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've fixed a few things:
[list]
[*] The bugs that happen using the Fast Travel System have been fixed;
[*] The bug in which your character disappears after you try to return to the Astoria port has been fixed;[/list]
Thank you for your feedback, and don't forget to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3125080/Dianas_Quest_2_Give_Back_My_Clothes/]Diana's Quest 2[/url] to your wishlist. A demo will be released in our [url=https://discord.gg/h7wgTK2Aea]Discord[/url] VERY SOON!
